content.comment_body: Hello, when I use the [product_name] app, I can only send one command before getting an 'ssl handshake failed' error. To restore functionality, I have to restart the app. I've already tried both iOS and Android devices, but the issue remains. How can I resolve this problem?

analysis.insight_summary: Users report a persistent connection issue with the [product_name] app, encountering an 'ssl handshake failed' error after sending one command. This occurs on both iOS and Android platforms, requiring an app restart each time to continue using the app. The instability disrupts workflow and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] app to provide a reliable and secure connection, enabling uninterrupted command sending without needing to restart the app.
